{{Quote|Any word on our project?"<br>"None. But I've tapped into the SAM database.|Bog Divinian and Sano Sauro|<ref name="Secret Weapon">''[[The Last of the Jedi: Secret Weapon]]''</ref>}}
'''Suspicious Movement''', otherwise known by its acronym '''SM''', or its nickname '''SAM''', was a program used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to check for suspicious activities.<ref name="Secret Weapon" />
==Organization and structure==
{{Quote|Suspicious Movement. Acronym SM. Nickname SAM. Stormtroopers and spies patrol Coruscant and keep their eyes open for suspicious activity. Do spot ID checks. It also goes on within worlds occupied by the Empire. Governors set up the programs. They all go into one database and are cross-referenced and cross-checked. Then the head security officer decides on surveillance.|Sano Sauro|<ref name="Secret Weapon" />}}
Suspicious Movement was a program to look out for suspicious doings through the use of [[Spy/Legends|spies]] or [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]]. They could do spot ID checks. A single database kept record of suspicions, where they could be cross-referenced and cross-checked. Then the [[Security officer/Legends|head security officer]] could decide on surveillance. The main operation of SAM was on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], but could be set up by [[Governor/Legends|Imperial Governors]] on other worlds occupied by the Galactic Empire.<ref name="Secret Weapon" />
==History==
{{Quote|How'd you do that? Get access to the database? Let's face it, your clearance must've been bumped down to almost zero, Sano-Mano."<br>"This is a naval academy. I'm still heading the search for any Force-adepts to join it. I have a valuable friendship with Hydra.|Bog Divinian and Sano Sauro|<ref name="Secret Weapon" />}}
Seven months after the rise of the Galactic Empire,<ref name="Date">''[[The Last of the Jedi: Return of the Dark Side]] says that [[Trever Flume]] has been travelling with [[Ferus Olin]] for roughly a month. [[The Last of the Jedi: Death on Naboo]] claims it takes place six months after [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala's]] funeral. Given Return of the Dark Side at most takes place over a few days and Secret Weapon follows on straight from it, that must mean that Secret Weapon takes place seven months after the rise of the Empire.''</ref> the former [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Sano Sauro]] sought to enlist [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-adepts]] into the [[Imperial Naval Academy/Legends|Imperial Naval Academy]],<ref name="A Tangled Web">''[[The Last of the Jedi: A Tangled Web]]''</ref> assisted by the use of the Suspicious Movement program to find Force-adepts. He made a valuable friendship with the newly appointed [[Grand Inquisitor/Legends|Grand Inquisitor]] [[Hydra (Grand Inquisitor)|Hydra]] to assist him. Sauro informed Governor [[Bog Divinian]] about his search into the database of SM. Divinian grew envious, leading him to wonder why SAM hadn't been implemented on [[Rosha]] yet and how Sauro had so quickly made a relation with Hydra considering Sauro's recent demotion. However, Sauro was taken off the hunt for Force-adepts by [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], with Ferus Olin taking Sauro's position in leading the hunt.<ref name="Secret Weapon" /> Ferus was assisted by Hydra and worked with her. Ferus began searching a list of suspects and rearranged them by priority.<ref name="Against the Empire">''[[The Last of the Jedi: Against the Empire]]''</ref> Ferus and Hydra later visited [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] in search of a Force-sensitive [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|toddler]].<ref name="Master of Deception">''[[The Last of the Jedi: Master of Deception]]''</ref> Ferus found the toddler's report to be a coincidence and put it at the lowest priority, but he was instructed by [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] to pretend to investigate it and dismiss the report.<ref name="Against the Empire" /> Ferus was able to learn the identity of the toddler as Leia Organa, and was able to discredit the report with a thorough plan. The outcome of the investigation led to Ferus being appointed as [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]'s second-in-command by Emperor Palpatine.<ref name="Master of Deception" />
